summary: Defines SMTP and MIME extensions that let a message originator state whether content may be converted, for example from colour to black and white, along the way. This allows conversion to be done conveniently in a store-and-forward mail environment. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Suppose you send a colour picture to a friend whose printer only prints black and white. This memo lets mail systems change the picture along the way, if you allowed it, so it still works for them.

questions: how to convert email content in transit
